input.claim_text: On 9 February 2024 I woke up to find someone had spray-painted graffiti all over our front fence and garage door overnight. It looks like it happened while we were asleep since there was nothing there when we went to bed. I haven't had anyone come out to quote on repainting or replacing the panels yet, so I don't have a cost figure at this stage.

output.cause: unknown person spray-painted graffiti on front fence and garage door overnight

input.query: Is graffiti/malicious damage to fences and garage doors covered?

output.answer:
Based on the provided excerpts, I cannot answer this question. The excerpts do not contain any information about graffiti or malicious damage cover, nor do they address fences or garage doors in that context. The pages provided cover topics such as accidental glass breakage, earthquake, flood/rainwater run-off, escape of water, lightning, storm surge/tsunami, riot/civil commotion, storm, and theft/attempted theft [NRMA Home PDS, pages 13-15], but none of these excerpts reference graffiti or malicious damage as an insured event.

To answer this question accurately, I would need excerpts from the policy specifically addressing "Malicious damage" or "Graffiti" cover.
